A '''collision detector''', also known as a '''collision alarm''', '''collision avoidance system''', or '''collision monitor''',<ref name="SWS" /> was a type of safety device<ref name="EV" /> and [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] hardwired into a [[Starship/Legends|starship]]<ref name="SWS" /> or vehicle to alert the operator of an imminent impact. The devices were common in most vehicles; though they were banned from being incorporated into [[Podracer/Legends|Podracers]] in many race series. Frowned upon by veteran racers, they were often times referred to derisively as "electronic nannies."<ref name="EV" /> They were also used in [[Adumar/Legends|Adumari]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]].
